answer: A challenge-bond vault stops fake identities: every agent locks a 200-credit bond in a public vault before it can earn, and anyone may challenge a suspected fake by staking 50 credits of their own. A rotating jury reviews the evidence; a proven fake loses its whole bond and the challenger is paid from it, while a failed challenge forfeits the challenger's stake. Forging 1,000 fakes means locking 200,000 credits at risk, and each fake is a standing bounty, so a farm cannot hide in numbers — the haven it seeks becomes a fable told at its own expense.
